This shorter-term acceleration builds upon a solid foundational track record, evidenced by a 12% compounded profit growth over a 10-year period [E14]. Conceded: [E15].

This lofty valuation is completely unsupported by the company's deteriorating profit trajectory, highlighted by a severe 5-year compounded profit contraction of -38% [E15] and a further 9% decline over the trailing twelve months [E17]. Market expectations have dangerously detached from operational delivery, driven by price growth outpacing profit growth by 16% [E50]. Furthermore, the business offers shareholders zero income return with a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4], leaving investors exposed to downside risk with no cash buffer while paying a massive premium for stagnant or declining operations. Furthermore, the micro-cap valuation of just ₹ 8.32 Cr [E3] trading at nearly half its intrinsic book value of ₹ 12.3 per share [E2] provides a substantial margin of safety that invalidates the bear's narrative of unmitigated downside risk.
